audit.whatIsWrong: win[] and phases[].side gave Gwen levels 2 and 3 and marked level 6 as even, contradicting whys[1], whys[2] and whys[4].
audit.why: Hookshot is a 16s rank-1 stun that Camille has before Gwen has Hallowed Mist at all, and it feeds a Precision Protocol true-damage second cast. At 6 Needlework plus the mist genuinely flips it, which whys[4] already says.
audit.corrected: Skill / Camille / Camille / Skill / Gwen / Gwen / Gwen.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns given for the abilities the whole plan is timed against.
audit.why: Hookshot 16/15/14/13/12, Precision Protocol 9/8/7/6/5, Tactical Sweep 15/14/13/12/11 and The Hextech Ultimatum 140/115/90 against Hallowed Mist's 22s. Her entry comes back faster than your answer until you rank W, which is exactly why levels 2-5 are hers.
audit.corrected: whys[1], spikes[0].text and early now carry the numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never says why Hallowed Mist fails inside The Hextech Ultimatum, and never names Precision Protocol as an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Riot's Hallowed Mist text: Gwen can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist. Camille's ult creates an arena she is locked inside with you, so she is always an enemy who has entered - the untargetability that defines this matchup is simply off. Separately, Precision Protocol carries the autoReset flag, so the attack wind-up, not the Q cast, is the moment the true-damage hit is coming.
audit.corrected: late and spikes[3].text now state the mist is off inside her ult; mid names the Precision Protocol reset as the tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tactical Sweep's heal is described as a 'cone heal' but no anti-heal item is ever named.
audit.why: Tactical Sweep carries the heal flag and heals off the slowed outer half, so the extended fight the page tells you to force is exactly the fight Grievous Wounds decides.
audit.corrected: whys[5], spikes[2].text and wants.you[1] now name Grievous Wounds against Tactical Sweep.

edits.before: Level 1 we're both soft, but Camille owns the lane the second she hits 2 — her E hookshot stun (off a wall it's a long one) into the second-cast Q true-damage crit out-stats me before I have Hallowed Mist to bail. Don't sit in E range when her Q is charged; last-hit at the tip of Snip Snip and eat a little poke rather than feed a wall-dash trade. Her W cone heals her on the slowed half, so a short Q-and-back just feeds her sustain — I farm to 6, not brawl on her terms.
edits.after: Level 1 you are both soft, but Camille owns the lane the second she hits 2 — Hookshot is a 16s stun at rank 1 (long off a wall) into a Precision Protocol true-damage second cast, and that out-stats you before Hallowed Mist exists. Do not sit in E range with her Q charged; last-hit at the tip of Snip Snip! and eat a little poke rather than feed a wall-dash trade. Tactical Sweep heals her on the slowed half, so a short Q-and-back just feeds her sustain — farm to 6, do not brawl on her terms.

edits.before: Six is the flip. When Camille E's in, I drop Hallowed Mist on top of myself as her stun lands — she's committed inside the fog while I'm untargetable to her from its edge, then Needlework slows her and Snip Snip's %-max-HP cone plus the true-damage center snip grind her down. Levels 4-5 before my W are still a coinflip if she hookshots me onto a wall, so don't over-extend until I have the mist button. Once Riftmaker is up, Thousand Cuts plus my ability healing eats her W heal in any drawn-out fight.
edits.after: Six is the flip. When Camille E's in, drop Hallowed Mist on top of yourself as her stun lands — she is committed inside the fog while you are untargetable to her from its edge, then Needlework slows her and Snip Snip!'s %-max-HP cone plus the true-damage centre snip grind her down. Her burst opens on a Precision Protocol auto reset, so the wind-up is your cue, not the cast. Levels 4-5 before your W are still a coinflip if she hookshots you onto a wall, so do not over-extend until you have the mist button.

edits.before: This is mine if I close it — at my first AP item the %-max-HP Snip Snip shreds and Thousand Cuts sustain out-grinds her cone heal, so I win the straight duel. The one thing that flips it is her R isolation: it walls me into a 1v1 where her wall-dash and reset Q tempo punish me if I'm out of Mist, so I keep Skip 'n Slash up to re-mist and never get caught dashing off terrain. Bait her E hookshot into the fog and let her Q reset whiff before I commit — don't fight her against a wall where her hookshot range explodes.
edits.after: This is yours if you close it — at your first AP item %-max-HP Snip Snip! shreds and A Thousand Cuts sustain out-grinds her cone heal, so you win the straight duel. The one thing that flips it is The Hextech Ultimatum: Hallowed Mist only hides you from enemies outside it, and her arena locks her inside it with you, so the mist is simply off in there. Keep Skip 'n Slash up, never get caught dashing off terrain, bait her Hookshot into the fog and let the Q reset whiff before you commit.

notes: Three problems. (1) The content block is in first person ('out-stats me', 'I drop Hallowed Mist'); converted early, mid, late and the whys to second person. (2) The full layer calls Camille 'he' throughout its template text (19 occurrences against 18 'she'); corrected. (3) The level chart disagreed between the prose and both layers at levels 2, 3 and 6 - whys[1] and whys[2] plainly describe Camille winning 2 and 3, while win[] and phases[] gave those to Gwen. The most useful missing fact is now stated: Hallowed Mist only protects Gwen from enemies OUTSIDE it, and The Hextech Ultimatum's arena keeps Camille inside melee range with you, so the mist button that wins this lane at 6 does nothing inside her ult. 'Thousand Cuts' was missing its 'A' in several places.
